answer: Reputation decays by 10% each epoch unless the owner pays a renewal fee that is itself priced by how many identities share a funding source. Holding one account in the lagoon costs a base fee; a cluster of k linked accounts pays k times that fee scaled by k, so the delta between honest and fake budgets widens. A farm hits its nadir when renewals exceed payouts, so each added fake head costs more than the last.
